propositions: Central immutable OperationSnapshot with validated non-secret values, explicit provenance source kinds, repository root, and envelope version must be composed once per CLI/library/MCP/direct-reconciler operation entry point in shadow mode without controlling execution

Composition precedence must enforce explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root independently selected as explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/cwd
Snapshot must exclude live auth objects, secret wrappers/values, provider clients, and source-file paths from all fields, fingerprint inputs, serialization, schemas, logs, and diagnostics

Malformed selected operation config must raise typed config error before lock/network/write effects occur; non-config shadow failures must not alter authoritative operation output while emitting redacted warnings
REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW migration switch must be enabled by default, readable only at approved composition boundary, disabled with canonical false spelling, and removed in S7

Representative ordinary ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler must produce identical snapshot values, source kinds, root, version, and redacted fingerprint from identical five-layer inputs
